ValidationRule.description: When the quote leaves Draft, every line must have Quantity 1 and Number of Users of 1 or more. Line rules skip Draft quotes, so reps see no validation errors in Browse Catalogs.
ValidationRule.errorConditionFormula: AND( ISCHANGED(Status), NOT(ISPICKVAL(Status, "Draft")), OR( Lines_Missing_Users__c > 0, Lines_Wrong_Quantity__c > 0 ) )
ValidationRule.errorMessage: Before moving the quote out of Draft, every line needs Quantity 1 and Number of Users of 1 or more. Check the Lines Wrong Quantity and Lines Missing Users fields.
